mapper.select: SELECT MAX(ATTEMPT_NO) FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT WHERE TARGET_ID = #{targetId}

SELECT ID, TARGET_ID, ATTEMPT_NO, ACCESS_TYPE, TASK_ID, EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID, EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID, STATUS, LEASE_TOKEN, LEASE_UNTIL, NEXT_ATTEMPT_AT, ERROR_CODE, ERROR_MESSAGE, RESULT_EVENT_ID, DISPATCHED_AT, CONFIRMED_AT, CONVERGED_AT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_TIME FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT WHERE ID = #{id} AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT SET TASK_ID = #{taskId}, EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID = NVL(#{externalBatchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID), EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID = NVL(#{externalCommandId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID), STATUS = 'WAITING_CONFIRM', DISPATCHED_AT = NVL(DISPATCHED_AT, #{updatedAt}), UPDATE_TIME = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{id} AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND LEASE_TOKEN = #{leaseToken} AND STATUS IN ('CLAIMED', 'SUBMITTING', 'WAITING_CONFIRM') AND (LEASE_UNTIL IS NULL OR LEASE_UNTIL > #{updatedAt}) AND (#{externalBatchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID IS NULL OR EXTERNAL_BATCH_ID = #{externalBatchId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{externalCommandId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID IS NULL OR EXTERNAL_COMMAND_ID = #{externalCommandId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_TARGET WHERE ID = #{targetId} AND LEASE_TOKEN = #{leaseToken} AND STATE IN ('EXECUTING', 'WAITING_CONFIRM') )

UPDATE SMT_AUTH_OPERATION_ATTEMPT SET STATUS = #{status}, RESULT_EVENT_ID = #{eventId}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CONFIRMED_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('CONFIRMED', 'CONVERGED') THEN #{updatedAt} ELSE CONFIRMED_AT END, CONVERGED_AT = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'CONVERGED' THEN #{updatedAt} ELSE CONVERGED_AT END, UPDATE_TIME = #{updatedAt} WHERE ID = #{attemptId} AND TARGET_ID = #{targetId} AND CASE STATUS WHEN 'CLAIMED' THEN 1 WHEN 'SUBMITTING' THEN 1 WHEN 'WAITING_CONFIRM' THEN 1 WHEN 'VERIFYING' THEN 2 WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 3 WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 3 WHEN 'CONVERGED' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END < CASE #{status} WHEN 'CLAIMED' THEN 1 WHEN 'SUBMITTING' THEN 1 WHEN 'WAITING_CONFIRM' THEN 1 WHEN 'VERIFYING' THEN 2 WHEN 'FAILED' THEN 3 WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 3 WHEN 'CONVERGED' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END
